source.title: Chocolate Ballerina Founder Chanel Holland-Pierre Shares Inspiring Business Journey - #GMD
source.description:
Ivan and Vincenza host a brand-new LIVE episode of Good Morning Delaware, featuring Chanel Holland-Pierre, CEO & Founder of Chocolate Ballerina Company.

In this inspiring interview, Chanel shares the story behind building Chocolate Ballerina Company, the mission driving the brand, and what motivated her to turn her vision into a growing business. From entrepreneurship to purpose-driven success, this conversation highlights what it takes to build something meaningful from the ground up.

Plus, get an inside look at what’s next for Chocolate Ballerina Company and how the brand continues to evolve.

👉 If you’re interested in entrepreneurship, small business success, and inspiring founder stories, this episode is a must-watch.

🔔 Subscribe for more local stories, business features, and community highlights from Delaware.
